description: This file defines an Android activity named Vertices that demonstrates the use of the Canvas.drawVertices() method. It contains an inner class SampleView which handles rendering a textured mesh, applying transformations, and user touch interactions to modify vertex positions.

classes.name: Vertices
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating custom drawing with vertices and touch interaction.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View class that renders a textured mesh with touch-based vertex manipulation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: setXY
methods.description: Utility method to set the x and y coordinates for a vertex in an array.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the vertices mesh onto the Canvas.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input to update vertex positions based on user interactions.
